title: HTTP, REST, status codes, caching headers, CORS

preview.what: How HTTP really works: methods, status codes, caching headers, CORS, REST conventions.
preview.picture: Postal system: the method is the type of letter, status codes are the reply stamps, cache headers say 'valid until', CORS is the receptionist asking which buildings may talk to this one.
preview.why: Explaining a 401 vs 403, or why a CORS error happens, is a routine screen.
preview.bn: Method = চিঠির ধরন, status code = উত্তরের সিল, cache header = কতদিন valid, CORS = কে কথা বলতে পারবে।
